summary: The interface cleanly implements the dark theme and typography, but the bottom input group is clipped at the viewport edge.

issues.title: Input clipped at bottom viewport boundary
issues.description: The caption refinement input box extends past the viewport, truncating its bottom border.
issues.evidence: The lower border of the 'refine caption' input group is cut off at the bottom right.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or constrain the sidebar height with internal scrolling.
